designations.fra: Minimum immersion depth of a temperature sensor

eng: Minimum immersion depth of a temperature sensor

terms.designation: Minimum immersion depth of a temperature sensor

definitions.content: Depth of immersion in a thermostatic bath with a temperature of (80 $ \pm $ 5) $ ^{\circ} $ C at an ambient temperature of (25 $ \pm $ 5) $ ^{\circ} $ C, beyond which deeper immersion changes the output value by an amount corresponding to less than 0.1 K.
